I know I probably need to add some more soon, but for now the house is quiet and there’s no cats fighting. Can’t speak for everybody else, but it worked for me.

claims.text: Most reviewers say the product effectively eliminates dog urine and poop odor in yards, on concrete, and on artificial turf.
Reviewers find it easy to use and appreciate that it neutralizes odor rather than just covering it with another scent.
Several reviewers note the effect is not long-lasting and requires frequent reapplication, often every couple of weeks or sooner.
Some reviewers find it expensive and wish it lasted longer or were sold locally to avoid shipping costs.
Reviewers with multiple dogs were skeptical at first but were surprised and pleased that it worked.
